metadata.name: Deep-Sea Sediment Core Data from Site 383-U1539C
metadata.description: High-resolution paleoceanographic dataset containing 150 sediment core samples from a single deep-sea location in the Southern Ocean. The data includes physical measurements, geographic coordinates, estimated ages, and Sea Surface Temperature (SST) reconstructions derived from the core, collected during a concentrated sampling campaign in late May to early June 2019.
metadata.spatial: Point locations (single core site, ~22m x ~27m bounding box)
metadata.temporal: High-frequency sampling over 5 days (batch data entry)
